article.title: Inland instrument.
article.content:
11Inland instrument.

Section 11  ·  Chapter II  ·  page 10 of the Act
A promissory note, bill of exchange or cheque drawn or made in 2[India] and made payable in, or drawn upon any person resident in, 2[India] shall be deemed to be an inland instrument.
2 Subs. by Act 36 of 1957, s. 3 and the Second Schedule “a State”.
